sentences.en: He was an indolent man, who lived only to eat, drink, and play at cards.
sentences.zh: 他是个懒惰的人，只知吃喝玩牌。

sentences.en: The project suffered because the manager was quite indolent.
sentences.zh: 由于项目经理相当懒惰，这个项目受到了影响。

sentences.en: It’s no wonder he failed; he has been so indolent in his studies.
sentences.zh: 难怪他会失败；他在学习上一直很懒惰。
